msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Use the EXACT garment(s) and accessories from the reference image: identical cut, length, fabric, colour, print, buttons, trims and details. Do not redesign, recolour or add garments. Show the clothes on a professional female fashion model (a woman). If the reference is a mirror selfie, the new photo has no phone, no mirror and no selfie pose. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia marea-modas-04.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): A stylish Spanish woman in her thirties wearing a cream jumper with black embroidery and brown barrel leg trousers from the reference, walking at a sunny street in Campanillas, Málaga, Spain, with white houses and palm trees, golden hour. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen, diptych, panel or collage. The subject stands in the right third of the frame and the same scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Wide editorial campaign image, cinematic natural light. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia marea-modas-04.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a cream knit jumper with black embroidered details, with brown barrel leg trousers from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia marea-modas-09.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a sheer black lace long-sleeved top, with a grey knit midi skirt from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia marea-modas-15.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a black short-sleeved top, with wide black and white zebra print trousers from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia marea-modas-21.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a burgundy knit top, with a black faux leather midi skirt with a front slit from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left.

IMAGEN 5 «b» (formato 16:9, sin referencia, aplica la REGLA C): Wide interior photo: the inside of a bright small women's fashion shop with a light wooden floor, white shelves of handbags, rails of knitwear and jeans and a white curtained fitting room, no people, no text, inspired by the reference, photographed like a design magazine, beautiful natural light, inviting and tidy. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen or collage.
